# Example mass breakdowns (generated by mass_model.py)

Assumptions for these examples: taper 0.6, airfoil t/c 9 %, fuselage length = 0.70 b, tail arm = 0.62 L, V_h = 0.45, V_v = 0.028, 4 servos EMAX ES9052MD (5.5 g), Matek F405-WTE (integrated ELRS), Matek M10Q GPS, 12-20 A ESC 12 g, 30 mm folding spinner, motor 30 g (2205/2206 class) and battery 3S 450 mAh 42 g unless stated. Spar sized at n_ult = 6 (4 g limit x 1.5), sigma_allow = 400 MPa. Contingency 5 % of non-battery, non-motor mass. Screening performance: rho = 1.09 kg/m3, CLmax = 1.2, turn at 45 deg bank with V = 1.3 Vs(banked).
